news.title: AI-trade rotation drags Nasdaq while Dow holds up post-election gains
news.text: Wednesday's post-midterm rally is fading Thursday: Yahoo Finance's live markets blog and 24/7 Wall St. both report the Dow holding roughly flat to higher while the S&P 500 and the tech-heavy Nasdaq slip as money rotates out of AI/semiconductor names. 24/7 Wall St. frames it as Big Tech dragging the Nasdaq toward its worst open in weeks even as Dow components post earnings beats.
